import sys

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n, K, L = map(int, input_line.split())
    mod = 998244353
    fif = enumFIF(10000, mod)
    muls = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(K, n + 1):
        m = C(n, i, mod, fif)
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            sign = 1 if (j - i) % 2 == 0 else -1
            muls[j] += m * C(n - i, n - j, mod, fif) * sign
            muls[j] %= mod
    ans = 0
    for i in range(K, n + 1):
        term = pow(2, i, mod) * fif[0][i] % mod * fif[0][i] % mod * fif[1][2 * i + 1] % mod * muls[i]
        ans += term
        ans %= mod
    if ans < 0:
        ans += mod
    print((ans * L) % mod)

def C(n, r, mod, fif):
    if n < 0 or r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return fif[0][n] * fif[1][r] % mod * fif[1][n - r] % mod

def pow(a, n, mod):
    result = 1
    base = a % mod
    while n > 0:
        if n & 1:
            result = result * base % mod
        base = base * base % mod
        n >>= 1
    return result

def enumFIF(n, mod):
    f = [1] * (n + 1)
    invf = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        f[i] = f[i - 1] * i % mod
    a = f[n]
    b = mod
    p, q = 1, 0
    while b > 0:
        c = a // b
        d = a
        a = b
        b = d % b
        d = p
        p = q
        q = d - c * q
    invf[n] = p % mod
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        invf[i] = invf[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod
    return [f, invf]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
